title: Axon and internal communications re Quote Q-865809 / Outpost (Jan–Oct 2026)
summary:
Companion to W013584-100626. On 2026-10-05 the City Council approved Amendment No. 1 to the City's Master Services and Purchasing Agreement with Axon Enterprise, Inc. (File 26-11633), which adds Axon Quote Q-865809-009 as Exhibit D. Covers 2026-01-01 through 2026-10-05:

- Item 1: communications between City staff and Axon Enterprise, Inc. (including any axon.com address or Axon portal message) that contain "Q-865809" or "Outpost", with attachments,
- Item 2: internal City communications that contain "Q-865809" or "Outpost".

The request offers to limit the search to those two terms.

policy_promises.quote: agency must notify requester within 10 calendar days whether it will produce records
policy_promises.tests: Does the City issue a determination by 2026-10-16?

prior_pra_refs.note: Same-day companion: earlier revisions of Quote Q-865809, other Axon ALPR quotes, and the agenda-scheduling records for File 26-11633.
Same-day companion: audits and audit trail for the Department's existing Axon Fleet 3 ALPR platform.

filed_because: A two-term keyword search for the City's correspondence with Axon, and its internal discussion, about the Outpost quote Council approved on 2026-10-05. Limiting the search to "Q-865809" and "Outpost" keeps it to a search the City can run quickly.
notes:
Filed 2026-10-06; auto-acknowledged the same day at 11:21 AM and forwarded to department(s) for processing. Statutory determination due 2026-10-16.

2026-10-15: SMPD invoked an extension under Gov. Code § 7922.535(b) and (c)(2), citing "the voluminous amount of potentially responsive records"; determination promised no later than 2026-10-30.

2026-10-30 (Elizabeth Briones, Police Records Supervisor): records produced and the request closed, on the extended determination date. "Portions of your request are being withheld" under Gov. Code § 7927.705 / Evidence Code § 954 (attorney-client privilege). The message does not say which items or how many records that covers, and no withholding log was produced.

Production: 30 PDF attachments, each a GovQA re-render (iText, 2026-10-28), so same-named copies differ by hash. By content: 8 emails, 11 quote copies and 11 copies of Axon marketing material.

Emails, in date order:
- 2026-02-10, Patrick Newton (Axon Account Executive, ALPR & Vehicle Intelligence) to Peruzzaro, O'Keefe and Riccardi, cc Tierney Stuhr (Axon Key Account Executive): follows an in-person meeting "last week" (early February 2026). Offers pricing for "Option A (full replacement) and Option B (identifying areas for expansion or enhanced livestream functionality) ... based on the current footprint of 72 fixed ALPR cameras". Carries Axon's SB 34 pitch: "Axon does not pool, resell, or repurpose agency ALPR detections unless a customer has explicitly authorized such use (e.g., through ACEIP)"; "Axon does not operate a national pool or enable automatic sharing"; Fusus sharing is "invite-only, visible, revocable". The attachment "AxonOutpost-Lightpost Bundles.pdf" is not in the production under that name.
- 2026-03-05 chain ("RE: ALPR"): Stuhr to O'Keefe after an Axon presentation on 2026-03-04 that O'Keefe and Casazza attended: "sounds like we will be back onsite on Thurs next week with you all to discuss ALPR in further detail at Chief's direction." Newton asks for "the current locations of your Flock Falcon ALPR cameras (including direction of capture), as well as any Condor livestream units" so Axon's project team can "assess feasibility and confirm we can expedite permitting/implementation"; O'Keefe replies "Funny, just produced this for a PRA." O'Keefe names Casazza as "our ALPR manager".
- 2026-04-13 and 04-14 (same chain): Newton: "Chief Barberini reached out to Tierney and Deanna today requesting that Axon finalize the agreement/proposal discussed in our previous meetings for Outpost fixed ALPR, in preparation for the upcoming Council meeting." The proposal is to show "no additional budget impact over the next 24 months and long-term cost savings". Riccardi proposes meeting after a command staff meeting; O'Keefe is on paternity leave.
- 2026-04-17, Stuhr to Chief Barberini, cc Newton and Riccardi: "Quote is attached here for the LPRs" (Q-841238-46129TS).
- 2026-07-28, Riccardi to Barberini, Peruzzaro, Casazza and Tricia Toomey: "I have drafted an AR for the Axon Outpost trial", attachment "Draft_Agenda_Report_Axon_Outpost_18_Month_Trial.docx" (not produced). "Axon has offered to come to any of the meetings or to set up a town hall style meeting for those that have questions if we think we need it."
- 2026-07-29, Riccardi to Casazza: "Updated_Agenda_Report_Axon_Outpost_ALPR_Only.docx" (not produced) with Q-865809. The "18 Month Trial" title is gone a day later; "ALPR Only" matches the Lightpost units dropped between Q-841238 and Q-865809-003.
- 2026-08-19, Riccardi to Barberini, City Manager Alex Khojikian, Laurie Strange and Martin McTaggart: Axon "would like to come out to San Mateo to do an in-person executive presentation on the Axon technology and ALPR's ... with up to two council members at a time"; attachment "San Mateo PD Axon council session.pdf" (not produced). No reply is in the production.
- 2026-08-25, Stuhr to Riccardi: "The quote now includes 40 cameras in year 1 with a $0 MSRP penalty clause and then 14 additional cams would ship in year 2 and the MSRP penalty clause would go back up to it's original intended rate", with the terms under "EXCEPTIONS TO STANDARD TERMS AND CONDITIONS". That describes revision -008 (see W013584); the quote files in this production are -003 and -009, so -008 is not here.
- 2026-10-02, Kathleen Hunt (Axon Sr. Customer Success Manager) to Riccardi and Casazza, three days before the Council vote: Axon is "encouraging customers to move all ALPR searching from Evidence.com to Fusus" and offers to disable ALPR search in Evidence.com; "ALPR sharing: You can now share ALPR data with other Axon LPR customers"; agencies can now edit the Overview and Policy statements of their Axon transparency portal; a virtual ALPR session is set for 2026-10-13. Read against the February email, agency-to-agency sharing is now a product feature.

Quote copies (11): Q-841238-46129TS (1, "Axon_Outpost_ALPR_Quote"), Q-865809-003 (8, the "7.31_..._Q-865809_-_MOD*" files and "Axon_ALPR_Only_updated_quote"), Q-865809-009 (2, "Axon_Outpost_quote_fix*"). Terms are analysed under W013584.

Axon material (11): "ALPR Council and Community Engagement Guide" (3 copies, 10 pp), "ALPR Program Details Worksheet" (3 copies: two of 7 pp, one of 14 pp), "Axon Vehicle Intelligence Boundaries" (2 copies, 3 pp) and the "Built for Public Safety. Governed for Accountability." governance guide (3 copies, 6 pp). All are generic Axon templates with no San Mateo content filled in. The worksheet tells agencies to "record your configuration and policy decisions before you adapt the Q&A" for public-facing materials, and the guide is titled "A practical guide for agency preparation, council approval and long-term governance".

Not in the production: any internal City email other than Riccardi's own; any reply from the Chief, the City Manager's office or Council staff; any Axon portal message; the two agenda-report drafts and the council-session plan named as attachments; and an itemised list of what the privilege withholding covers. Axon's emails describe the Chief directing the process ("at Chief's direction", "Chief Barberini reached out ... requesting that Axon finalize the agreement"), but no email from him was produced.

2026-11-02 supplemental release (Elizabeth Briones, Police Records Supervisor): "Upon further review of your original request, it was determined that a technical issue during the initial upload resulted in only 30 files being successfully transmitted. The issue has since been identified and the remaining responsive, disclosable records are now being provided as a supplemental release." The request remains closed. The portal now lists 215 attachment links (155 new files, about 117 distinct documents once GovQA re-render duplicates are collapsed).

By content: 78 distinct emails dated 2026-02-10 to 2026-10-05; Axon quote copies Q-841238-46129 (4), Q-865809-46182 (1), Q-865809-003 (3), Q-865809-008 (7) and Q-865809-009 (6, including "Quote_for_ALPR_-_Final"); MSPA Amendment No. 1 drafts ("DRAFT", "Axon 090826", "SMPD Edits 2026_09_10", "FINAL" and "FINAL_2029_09_22" [sic]); "San_Mateo_PD_-_Termination_MSRP"; "SMPD_ALPR_Vendor_Comparison" (18 pp); "SMPD_LPR" (5 copies); "LTR_-_ALPR__San_Mateo_"; "Outpost_Site_Selection_Guide"; Axon ALPR Council Toolkit print pieces (Boundaries, Q&A, Readiness Checklist, Audit Checklist); the 10/5 Council agenda packet (207 pp); and one public comment on the 10/5 item forwarded by the Deputy City Clerk.

Every attachment the 10/30 release listed as "not produced" is now in it: "AxonOutpost-Lightpost_Bundles", "Draft_Agenda_Report_Axon_Outpost_18_Month_Trial" (two versions), "Updated_Agenda_Report_Axon_Outpost_ALPR_Only" (two versions), "San_Mateo_PD_Axon_council_session" and the Q-865809-008 quote. The "Not in the production" paragraph above describes the 10/30 release only. The supplemental includes internal City email beyond Riccardi's, emails from Chief Barberini, email to the City Manager, and a City Clerk poll of the Council with Council replies:
- 2026-08-07, Chief Barberini to City Manager Alex Khojikian, Riccardi and Peruzzaro, cc Casazza, "Opportunity for Council Prep Sessions with Axon Next Week" (attachment "Richmond Council Session.pdf"): Axon "will be in Richmond next week meeting with their councilmembers regarding the ALPR system" and offered "council prep specifically on Axon's ALPR platform"; "Axon can meet individually or with up to two members at a time."
- 2026-08-20, City Clerk Martin McTaggart, "Council Poll: Axon Technology Briefing Availability", to Barberini and Riccardi, cc Khojikian, with the full City Council Bcc'd: Axon offered an in-person briefing "primarily on Axon's Automated License Plate Recognition (ALPR) technology, including its Outpost fixed license plate reader and video solution", plus "Dedrone airspace security" and "potential contract scope, and financial considerations", as "several identical one-hour small-group sessions (maximum of two Council Members per session)" on 2026-08-25 and 2026-09-01. Replies and scheduling run 2026-08-21 to 2026-09-02, with replies from Mayor Adam Loraine, Danielle Cwirko-Godycki, Nicole Fernandez and Lisa Diaz Nash; one Cwirko-Godycki reply copies Rob Newsom.
- Chief Barberini also appears on the "AXON LPR Quote" chain (2026-04-17, 05-15, 06-04, 08-26), "AR for Axon Outpost" (07-28), "Axon briefing for council" (08-20) and the Amendment No. 1 chain (09-22).
- 2026-05-18: Tricia Toomey (PD Business Manager, Support Services) forwarded the Chief's 2026-05-15 "FW: AXON LPR Quote", with attachment "SMPD LPR.xlsx", from her City account to a personal Gmail account in her own name.
- The Amendment No. 1 negotiation between Toomey and Axon's Tierney Stuhr runs 2026-09-08 to 2026-09-22, with Riccardi and Barberini on the final round.
- Also present: "Axon Fusus ALPR demo" (2026-06-09/10, Casazza with Newton and Stuhr), "LPR Scope of Work" (2026-03-16), "LPR Site Locations" (2026-09-02, Axon's Ryan Wells), "Outpost New Quote" and "New Quote + Added Terms" (2026-07-20 to 07-31), "Meeting with Chief Barberini" (2026-09-24/28, via Santiago), "DRAFT Axon ALPR AR - Council 10/5" (2026-09-16, Capt. Maravillas) and "Axon Fusus Release Notes 2026.26" (2026-07-27).

This is an inventory taken from message headers and a few short emails. The supplemental's content has not yet been reviewed in full against the analysis above.
